all.source_quote: The student must belong to Scheduled Castes (SC) or Neo-Buddhist categories.
The annual income of the student’s parents should be more than ₹2.50 lakh.
The student should be pursuing education after the matriculation examination.

unmodelled.text: Must be a resident of Maharashtra (the app checks the state; proof is still needed)
unmodelled.source_quote: The student should be a resident of Maharashtra.

ambiguous: Neo-Buddhist applicants are eligible too, but the app has no Neo-Buddhist category, so they must answer SC (Buddhists are in the SC order since 1990; this page does not say so)
'After the matriculation examination' is mapped to class 11, class 12, diploma, undergraduate and postgraduate
The income limit is for the student's parents; the app asks annual family income

en.title: Education and Exam Fee Reimbursement for SC Students (Maharashtra)
en.benefit: Education fees, exam fees and other prescribed fees for recognised post-matric courses, paid to the college.
en.how_to_apply: Apply online on mahadbtmahait.gov.in through your college; the district Assistant Commissioner of Social Welfare approves it.
